title: Iki run output (iki/v1)
description: What an action's command writes to output.json: the entities it changes and creates, within what its action declares. Iki writes all of it in one transaction, or none of it.

origin.description: Where an imported entity came from: a public database, or a file the run was given. Iki keeps it with the entity, for anyone who reads it.

source.description: The database or format, such as `NCBI Nucleotide`, `RCSB PDB` or `GenBank file`.

id.description: Its identifier there: an accession, or a record's name in a file.

version.description: The record's version or the database's release, such as `L09137.2` or `2026-11`.

url.description: Where people can see the record.

sha256.description: The SHA-256 of the record as the command read it.

file.description: The file it was read from: one of the run's file params.

updates.description: By input name (one the action declares it updates): the entities it was given there, and the new values of fields the action declares.

entity.description: The input entity's ID, from input.json.

creates.description: New entities, of types the action declares it creates.

derived_from.description: The input entities it was made from. Leave it out when the declared inputs it's derived from hold one entity.

metrics.description: Numbers about the run, such as a score or a count, kept on the run.

messages.description: Notes for whoever reads the run.
